program.merge_policy: accumulate twenty 25-entry deep passes; consolidate and validate once after Wave 2500

source_provenance: Direct public PubMed/PMC abstracts and ordinary web research
source-specific manual result-direction, population, route, formulation, observational, and safety calibration

policy.validation_strategy: deep source calibration per pass; expensive repository-wide validation after Wave 2500

rejected_candidates.title: Circular economy in seafood processing: turning crustacean by-products into astaxanthin bioresources.
rejected_candidates.reason: industrial food-processing/extraction review; not human supplement efficacy or safety evidence

waves.title: Administration of N-acetylcysteine influence the expression of apoptotic genes in the granulosa cells of infertile women diagnosed with endometriosis.
waves.finding: NAC increased serum antioxidant markers and shifted granulosa-cell apoptosis-related gene expression toward lower pro-apoptotic and higher anti-apoptotic signaling.
waves.safety: This very small study measured biomarkers and gene expression, not pregnancy or live-birth outcomes; mechanistic changes should not be presented as proven fertility benefit.

waves.title: Vitamin D Status and Supplementation in Chronic Rhinosinusitis: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
waves.population: 15 studies of vitamin-D status plus 4 RCTs of supplementation in chronic rhinosinusitis
waves.finding: People with chronic rhinosinusitis had lower vitamin-D levels than controls, and supplementation modestly improved SNOT-22 symptoms before three months, but the benefit was not maintained at three months or longer.
waves.safety: Status associations and short-term treatment effects should remain separate; long-term efficacy is unproven.

waves.title: Maternal Iodine Status During Pregnancy and Child Neurodevelopment: A Systematic Review and Dose-Response Meta-Analysis of Prospective Cohort Studies.
waves.study: systematic review/dose-response meta-analysis of prospective cohorts
waves.finding: Suboptimal maternal iodine status was associated with modestly poorer child neurodevelopment, especially cognition, with exploratory curves suggesting best outcomes around mid-range iodine exposure.
waves.safety: Prospective association does not establish that supplementation improves neurodevelopment, and excessive iodine may also be undesirable.

waves.title: Vitamins and nutraceuticals in glaucoma research.
waves.population: mixed preclinical and human glaucoma evidence across 35 vitamins, minerals, and nutraceuticals
waves.finding: The review identifies plausible retinal-ganglion-cell and metabolic targets for several nutraceuticals, but evidence strength varies widely and no unified supplement regimen is established.
waves.safety: Broad review evidence cannot support ingredient-specific efficacy without source-level trials.

waves.title: Efficacy and safety of microneedling with tranexamic acid versus microneedling with vitamin C in the treatment of melasma: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.finding: Microneedling with vitamin C produced short-term melasma outcomes statistically similar to microneedling with tranexamic acid in this limited evidence base.
waves.safety: This is transdermal microneedling delivery, not oral vitamin-C supplementation; short follow-up cannot establish long-term recurrence or safety.

waves.title: Effect of sesame oil and Nigella sativa oil on the prevention of amiodarone-induced phlebitis: a randomized controlled trial.
waves.finding: Topical sesame oil and Nigella sativa oil reduced incidence and severity of infusion-related phlebitis versus no intervention, with sesame oil showing the lowest observed rate.
waves.safety: This is topical catheter-site use in an inpatient setting and cannot support oral black-seed-oil supplement claims.

waves.title: Kava Withdrawal Treated With Phenobarbital-A Case Report and Literature Review.
waves.population: one heavy kava user with severe withdrawal; review of 9 prior withdrawal-related studies
waves.finding: A heavy kava user developed hyperactive delirium and autonomic agitation after stopping and improved with phenobarbital-based treatment; prior controlled low-dose cessation studies generally reported no withdrawal, while severe heavy-use evidence was sparse.
waves.safety: Important rare-event signal, but a single severe case cannot define incidence or establish a standard treatment protocol; medical management should remain clinician-directed.

waves.title: Dietary Polyphenols and Selected Nutraceuticals in Hepatocellular Carcinoma: Mechanistic Insights, Translational Evidence, and Clinical Prospects.
waves.population: epidemiologic, experimental, and limited clinical HCC literature
waves.finding: Polyphenols and nutraceuticals affect multiple HCC-related signaling pathways in preclinical models, but clinical translation is limited by bioavailability, formulation heterogeneity, and lack of high-quality trials.
waves.safety: Mechanistic antitumor activity must not be represented as established cancer treatment efficacy.

waves.title: Impact of Melatonin Supplementation on Glycemic Parameters in Patients with Type 2 Diabetes: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis.
waves.finding: Melatonin supplementation reduced fasting glucose, fasting insulin, HbA1c, and HOMA-IR in pooled randomized trials.
waves.safety: Dose/duration subgroup findings are exploratory and should not be converted into dosing guidance; larger trials are still needed.

waves.title: Probiotic mediated modulation of neonatal health: a meta-analysis of prematurity-related morbidity, jaundice, and respiratory distress.
waves.finding: Probiotics were associated with less neonatal jaundice, lower bilirubin, reduced phototherapy need, lower respiratory-distress incidence, and shorter respiratory support.
waves.safety: Strains, formulations, doses, and protocols varied and long-term safety data were limited; routine neonatal implementation is not established.

waves.title: Meta-analysis of the efficacy and safety of L-carnitine and N-acetylcysteine monotherapy for male idiopathic infertility.
waves.finding: L-carnitine and NAC monotherapy each improved several semen parameters versus placebo; L-carnitine also increased testosterone in pooled analyses.
waves.safety: The paper synthesizes two distinct interventions and reports surrogate semen outcomes rather than pregnancy or live-birth benefit.

waves.title: Role of the EPA: DHA dosing ratio in omega-3 supplements on blood fatty acid profiles and inflammation: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.population: healthy and clinical populations receiving EPA+DHA supplements
waves.finding: EPA:DHA ratio influenced blood fatty-acid profiles and inflammatory biomarkers, with different ratios favoring different biomarker outcomes.
waves.safety: Dose- and ratio-response analyses are formulation-level evidence and cannot establish a universally optimal consumer ratio or dose.

waves.title: Ginkgo diterpene lactone meglumine for functional recovery in patients with acute ischemic stroke: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.finding: Ginkgo diterpene lactone meglumine added to conventional treatment improved 90-day functional outcomes with moderate-certainty evidence.
waves.safety: This is a specific Chinese patent-medicine formulation used adjunctively in acute stroke, not evidence for generic oral Ginkgo supplements.

waves.title: The effect of caffeine consumption on age-related macular degeneration: a systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.finding: Caffeine consumption was not significantly associated with early or late AMD development; limited vote-counting evidence suggested possible slower progression, largely from tea exposure.
waves.safety: Beverage-consumption observational data cannot establish protective caffeine supplementation effects.

waves.title: Effects of probiotic supplementation on glycemic control in children with type 1 diabetes: A systematic review and meta-analysis.
waves.finding: Probiotics modestly reduced HbA1c and insulin requirements, while fasting glucose was not significantly reduced; effects varied by formulation.
waves.safety: Pediatric disease-specific evidence and formulation dependence preclude a category-wide recommendation.

waves.title: Effect of multistrain probiotics on symptom severity in irritable bowel syndrome: a systematic review and meta-analysis of irritable bowel syndrome-symptom severity score outcomes.
waves.finding: Multistrain probiotics reduced total IBS symptom-severity scores and several subscores, but heterogeneity was extreme and IBS-specific quality-of-life improvement was not consistent.
waves.safety: Very high heterogeneity and multi-strain formulation differences limit product-level inference.

waves.title: Meta-analysis of probiotic metabolites in the prevention of gestational weight gain and postpartum weight retention.
waves.finding: Probiotic interventions were associated with lower gestational weight gain and postpartum weight retention and modest improvements in several metabolic markers.
waves.safety: Pregnancy is a special population and effects were strongest with particular multispecies/timing patterns; strain and protocol heterogeneity matter.

waves.title: The therapeutic readiness of probiotics in major depressive disorder: A systematic review of randomised controlled trials.
waves.study: systematic review of 13 double-blind placebo-controlled RCTs
waves.finding: Most trials reported modest adjunctive improvement in depressive symptoms, especially with multi-strain Lactobacillus/Bifidobacterium formulations in younger outpatients, but effects varied by setting and population.
waves.safety: Probiotics appeared generally well tolerated; formulation heterogeneity and reported industry relationships reinforce the need for independent replication.

waves.title: Effectiveness and safety of turmeric for the treatment of COVID-19: An updated systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials.
waves.population: 1,407 people with mild-to-severe COVID-19, mostly hospitalized
waves.finding: Turmeric/curcumin adjuncts were associated with lower mortality, mechanical ventilation, and clinical deterioration and higher symptom resolution; nano-curcumin was the most common formulation.
waves.safety: Most evidence involved adjunctive, bioavailability-enhanced formulations in acute COVID care and nine trials were high risk of bias; generic turmeric-supplement claims would overgeneralize.

waves.title: The Effect of Diet and Dietary Supplements on Iron Status of Active Females: A Systematic Review and Meta-analysis of Interventional Trials.
waves.finding: Oral ferrous sulfate supplementation increased hemoglobin and ferritin in active women, with moderate heterogeneity.
waves.safety: Benefits concern iron-status correction in a population at elevated deficiency risk and do not justify iron supplementation without assessing iron status.

waves.title: Effect of iron therapy on fatigue symptoms in non-anaemic iron deficient women of reproductive age- A Randomized Controlled Trial.
waves.population: 164 non-anemic iron-deficient women aged 18-45 with fatigue
waves.finding: Two months of iron therapy reduced fatigue and increased ferritin and hemoglobin versus baseline/placebo comparison in iron-deficient women without anemia.
waves.safety: Benefit applies to documented iron deficiency; indiscriminate iron use carries risk and should not be generalized to iron-replete fatigue.

waves.title: Effect of Calcium Citrate Versus Calcium Carbonate on Parathyroid Hormone Levels in Patients Undergoing Bariatric Surgery: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis of Randomized Controlled Trials.
waves.finding: Calcium citrate had more favorable single-dose calcium/PTH pharmacodynamic effects than calcium carbonate, but chronic interventions showed no significant difference in PTH or serum calcium.
waves.safety: Post-bariatric absorption is a special clinical context and short-term formulation differences do not establish long-term superiority.

waves.title: The impact of maternal vitamin D levels during pregnancy and risk of autism spectrum disorder and attention deficit hyperactivity disorder diagnosis and symptoms in offspring: a systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis.
waves.study: systematic review/dose-response meta-analysis of observational studies
waves.population: 15 studies of maternal vitamin-D status and offspring ASD/ADHD outcomes
waves.finding: Higher maternal vitamin-D status was associated with modestly lower ASD and ADHD risk, including a dose-response association for ASD.
waves.safety: This is maternal status association evidence and does not prove that vitamin-D supplementation prevents ASD or ADHD.

waves.title: Nutraceuticals in the clinical management of women with breast cancer; a narrative review.
waves.population: women treated for or surviving breast cancer
waves.finding: The review discusses nutraceutical use for quality-of-life and treatment-related concerns but does not provide a focused quantitative efficacy synthesis sufficient for ingredient-level promotion.
waves.safety: Cancer-treatment interactions and indication-specific safety require source-level review before any recommendation.

waves.title: Is the Juice Worth the Squeeze? Vitamin C Supplementation in Hemodialysis Patients: A Systematic Review.
waves.finding: Vitamin C deficiency is common in hemodialysis; supplementation showed the most consistent benefit for functional iron deficiency and restless-legs symptoms, while effects on inflammation and other comorbidities were inconsistent.
waves.safety: Hemodialysis is a special population with altered vitamin handling; evidence does not support routine vitamin C for all dialysis-related conditions.
